title: Resolution-normalized sequence-adjoint shift interfaces
statement: For a coefficient system calculus, its actual sequence-site ordinary and derived adjoints and simultaneous replacement data [def-pur-sequence-adjoint-resolution-data], define the resolution-normalized shift interface. It consists of coherent integer shifts of the left and right derived adjoints, their reduction and total-limit comparison squares, the shifted quasi-isomorphism and degreewise signed-resolution equations, the right-resolution comparison on every simultaneous replacement, and compatibility of the same adjunction unit and counit with these shifts. The shifted replacement is the ordinary shift comparison followed by the shifted given replacement map.
